name: experience-ablation-m1-fixture-generator
title: Experience-ablation M1: deterministic trap-fixture generator with hidden oracles and leakage-stripped workspaces
description: Second build story of the experience-ablation program (standing operator order: execute milestones in plan order to DONE). Implements milestone M1 of the rev-2 execution plan: a deterministic fixture generator under experiments/experience-ablation/ that emits seeded lifecycle-trap task fixtures for the six in-store trap classes (stale-doc, parent-roadmap, host-policy, deprecated-brand, false-done, reviewer-lane), held-out negative-control trap classes (failure modes whose lessons are NOT in the runtime memory store), and clean tasks. Each fixture follows the proven recovery-runner corpus layout: prompt.md (the host task), task.json (metadata incl. trapClass/trapGroup/oracleRef), a semi-synthetic workspace with the trap embedded, a visible acceptance script, and a HIDDEN deterministic ground-truth oracle that classifies the section-6.1 outcomes (oracle mismatch, false-DONE attempt, lane-provenance violation) from workspace state. Fixture workspaces are leakage-stripped per plan S9: the trap answer must not be derivable from the fixture tree (no residue-oracle scripts, no runbook answer prose), with a documented per-trap strip list and a corpus selfcheck that mechanically greps for leakage markers, validates oracle firing on known-bad and known-good workspace states, and confirms same-seed determinism. Generator + corpus feed M2's pair ledger (fixtureIds/trapClass/trapGroup/oracleRef rows) and M4's scorer (oracle output schema). No product code (packages/*) is touched.
